text: The Snake repo has no build tool; a pom.xml (Maven, Java 11, sourceDirectory=src) was added in PR#1 as the project foundation
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md added in PR#2 is the canonical modernization plan for the Snake project — BA reads this to create issues
Snake modernization uses FlatLaf (Apache 2.0) for modern Swing theming and javax.swing.Timer to replace Thread.sleep game loop
